task.description:
Run the PD-10 test suite and produce a report.

Run the following commands in order:
```bash
zig build
zig build test
zig build test-integration   # if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is set
```

Write the test report to `tests/reports/WF02-pd10-20260521-run-01.md` using the standard report format (see other reports in tests/reports/ for the template).

Report PASS if all tests pass. Report FAIL if any test fails, listing each failure with:
- Test case ID
- Expected result
- Actual result
- Severity (BLOCKER / MAJOR / MINOR)
